modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
A paper pop-up city unfolds out of a book. One model forgets it's made of paper.

Kling 4.0 on top, Seedance 2.5 on the bottom. Top or bottom?

Same prompt, one 10s take each, no rerolls.

Kling 4.0 (top) starts strong: the pages fold up like real paper and the river runs under a paper bridge. By second 3 the buildings look like painted plaster, not paper.

Seedance 2.5 (bottom) keeps the paper look all the way down to street level. But its river ends up running along the page edge instead of through the city.

originalPrompt: A thick hardcover book lies open on a wooden desk in a cozy lamp-lit study. A whole paper pop-up city unfolds out of the pages: buildings fold up floor by floor, a paper bridge snaps into place over a blue paper river, a tiny paper tram starts rolling along its track, and paper birds flap off the rooftops. The camera dives down from above the desk to street level between the paper buildings while tiny paper people walk and wave. Warm cozy 3D animated style, soft lamp light, rich detail. No text.
